alt: 兩名孩子圍著桌上的雙錐木製裝置，一人皺眉抓頭、另一人側身細看，都對看似往上滾動的物體感到困惑。
scene_prompt: At a hands-on science table a child stares in intense bafflement at an optical illusion sculpture: from the child's viewpoint two curved wooden rails seem to let a double cone roll uphill. The child furrows brows, scratches head with one hand and holds the other palm up, unable to understand. A peer examines from the side equally puzzled. Keep the apparatus visually clear as a surprising object, no answer diagram, no lightbulb, no question marks or text.
